Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick 15-min infra check before demo

Hi Mateo,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday and our Product team really likes the feature set. Before we lock in a full demo with your AE, we'd like a short 15-minute technical touch to confirm a few things: our VPC networking constraints, S3-based model artifacts access, and whether private deployment (VPC) is supported for our compliance needs.

I can do a short call tomorrow morning Pacific. Can you or someone on your side do a quick compatibility check? If possible, please include an engineer who can answer network/infra questions.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform
Retailix

- Which cloud provider/region are you planning to run (AWS-us-west-2, GCP-us-central1, etc.)?
- Do you have strict egress restrictions (no outbound internet) or are you okay with limited egress for key management and routing?

I'm going to loop in our AE (Marissa) and one of our infra engineers (Dev) so we can answer the network details on the call. I have the following windows tomorrow (all Pacific):

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Thanks for the ping — I’ll be on the 10:30 PT call and will bring the allowlist details. Preliminary notes from my side:
- For Private (VPC) deployment we support customer-managed VPC peering and endpoints in us-west-2.
- If you have strict egress, we can recommend a minimal set of outbound endpoints for KMS, image pull, and telemetry; I’ll confirm IPs on the call.
- For S3 artifacts we recommend either a read-only IAM role with STS or VPC S3 gateway endpoints; both are supported.

I’ll drop a calendar invite with Meet link and attach a short one-pager after the call.

—Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
